statement.text:
Let A E be the smallest class of locally compact groups such that
  (1) A E contains the compact groups and the discrete amenable groups;
  (2) A E is closed under taking closed subgroups, Hausdorff quotients, directed
      unions of open subgroups, and group extensions.
Is every amenable locally compact group an element of A E ?
    (A negative answer would follow from a positive answer to 19.21.)   P. Wesolek
